summary: First iteration: comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Appetiser India site. 9/9 backend pytest tests passed (health, root, enquiry create/persist, idempotency, honeypot 400, consent 422, idea<20 422, invalid interest 422, rate limit 429, Mongo persistence). All required frontend flows verified via Playwright: home hero + nav testids, section reveal on scroll (our-products, product-bitbyte-restro, bitbyte-story, final-cta), story tabs 0-3, try-menu-preview on scan scene, full BitByte MenuDemo flow (add pizza -> view cart -> place order -> success -> restart), /products list + explore-bitbyte-restro navigation to /products/bitbyte-restro (product-detail-heading + product-overview-heading + bitbyte-story), /services /about render, /careers shows no-open-roles + careers-introduce-link + send-resume, /contact empty-form errors (error-name, error-work_email, error-idea, error-consent), preselect via ?interest=BitByte%20Restro (aria-pressed=true on contact-interest-2), full valid submission returns contact-success + contact-receipt REFERENCE / <id>, mobile-menu-toggle -> mobile-nav-products navigation on 390x844 viewport with zero horizontal overflow, back-to-top scrolls to y=0, NotFound page rendered for /xyz-unknown, no broken images on Home, no console errors.

issues: Non-blocking framer-motion warning: 'container has a non-static position' for useScroll offset — informational only, does not affect UX.

action_items: Optional: send-another-enquiry intentionally keeps name/email/company (only clears idea + consent). The spec said 'resets form' — clarify intent; current behaviour is arguably better UX. If a full reset is desired, extend the onClick to reset all fields.
Optional: address framer-motion useScroll 'non-static position' warning by adding position:relative to the scrolled container in ProductStory/Home.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py enquiry rate limit uses ISO string comparison of created_at ($gte); works because created_at is stored as ISO string too, but comparing datetimes as strings is fragile — recommend storing as native BSON datetime and querying with datetime objects.
server.py stores idempotent lookups by request_id which is fine; unique index is also created — good.
Contact.jsx is a very large single-line JSX block (~500+ chars per line). Consider splitting into subcomponents for readability/maintainability.
All interactive elements have data-testid — good testability coverage.
seed_data_creation: Created ~10 TEST_/e2e enquiry docs in MongoDB enquiries collection during rate-limit/persistence tests (safe to leave or prune).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all enquiry validation paths and rate limit; use for regression. Frontend fully passes; note that try-menu-preview only appears when story-tab-0 (scan) is active — switch to tab-0 first before looking for it. Story sections use IntersectionObserver so scrollIntoView + 1s wait is required. Rate-limit test creates 5 enquiries with same email; use unique emails elsewhere.
